title: The closure of the image of a locally finite family of closed subsets stays locally finite under a quasi-compact morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that pushing forward a locally finite family of closed subsets along a quasi-compact morphism keeps the family of closures locally finite (statement lines 1846-1855). The proof tests local finiteness against an arbitrary quasi-compact open of the target, uses quasi-compactness of the morphism to pull it back to a quasi-compact open where the family is finite, and identifies the relevant index sets. The reduction to quasi-compact opens is the substance, so the claim is H2.
